{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify rows with invalid age (-1)
invalid_ages = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] < 0]

# Check how these invalid rows are distributed across channels and segments
invalid_distribution = invalid_ages.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().reset_index(name='count')

# Check the distribution of valid ages
valid_ages = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] >= 0]
valid_age_stats = valid_ages['customer_age'].describe()

invalid_distribution, valid_age_stats"}
